'''''Aristea capitata''''', commonly known as the '''blue sceptre''' or '''blouvuurpyl''', is a cormous geophyte belonging to the genus ''[[Aristea]]''. The species is endemic to the [[Western Cape]] and occurs from [[Piketberg]] and the upper reaches of the [[Olifants River (Western Cape)|Olifants River Valley]] to the [[Kleinrivier Mountains|Kleinrivier]] and [[Riviersonderend Mountains]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Aristea capitata (L.) Ker Gawl.|url=https://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=1515-10|work=REDLIST Sanbi}}</ref> The plant has an extent of occurrence of 23,963 km² and is part of the [[fynbos]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Aristea capitata (L.) Ker Gawl.|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:435944-1|work=Plants of the World Online}}</ref>
